sources.title: FP16 vs FP8 vs INT4 Inference Cost: Quality and GPU Fit
sources.snippet: FP16 vs FP8 vs INT4 inference cost has no universal winner. The procurement choice is the lowest total cost among configurations that satisfy the workload's declared quality floor, latency limits, and capacity requirement. FP8 W8A8 changes both weights and activations; INT4 W4A16 changes weights while retaining higher precision activations.
